name: Member's Mark Stuffed Bell Peppers with Beef & Rice (Warning)
whyItWorks: Whole raw green and red bell pepper pods filled with ground beef and rice. Thick bell pepper skin is wax-coated insoluble cellulose that resists stomach acid and can cause mechanical blockage at stricture sites.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture & Skin Warning: Scoop out the inner seasoned beef and rice filling; discard the tough outer bell pepper skin completely.
